definitions.explanation: A Japanese banknote with a face value of 1,000 yen. One of the most commonly used denominations in daily transactions.

examples.japanese: {千円札|せんえんさつ}で{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid with a thousand-yen bill.

examples.japanese: {千円札|せんえんさつ}を{小銭|こぜに}に{崩|くず}してください。
examples.english: Please break this thousand-yen bill into coins.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}の{中|なか}に{千円札|せんえんさつ}が{三枚|さんまい}しか{残|のこ}っていなかった。
examples.english: There were only three thousand-yen bills left in my wallet.

notes:
USAGE:
The most commonly used paper currency denomination in Japan for everyday purchases. As of 2024, the new design features {北里柴三郎|きたさとしばさぶろう}.

RELATED:
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}: 5,000-yen bill
- {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}: 10,000-yen bill
- {紙幣|しへい}: paper currency, banknote
- {硬貨|こうか}: coin
